name: Mummy Wasp Swarm
source: Starfinder Guilt of the Grave World

defensiveAbilities.name: Mummy Storm
defensiveAbilities.description: Millions of enchanted paper shreds orbit the swarm in a 10ft Type:emanation. Creatures inside this aura gain greater cover from the attacks of creatures outside of it. Any living creature that enters the aura or begins its turn inside it must succeed at a DC 22 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1.

defensiveAbilities.name: Rejuvenation
defensiveAbilities.description: When a mummy wasp swarm is destroyed, the hive's necromantic energies reanimate a new swarm over 1d6 days. A reforming mummy wasp swarm is destroyed permanently if its hive is consecrated or destroyed (30 HP) with vitality, water, or fire damage.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Unliving Stings
offensiveAbilities.description: Each creature in the swarm's space takes 2d10 Void Damage damage (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature that fails its save additionally takes 2d6 Persistent,void Damage damage (double damage on a critical failure).
